scope: Diagnostic next-decision candidate only; no action dispatch, task mutation, user reply or A0 success claim.
reconstruction: Captured state/output allowance/bootstrap retained. Captured contracts retain exact historical system/schema/docs; current contracts explicitly regenerate them and ground references from actual prior exposure. Corrected context uses current history projection. All changes recorded in input-diff.json; optional purpose omission in context-diff.json.

declared_model_provenance.purpose: Stage a feasible local planner candidate for a frozen A/B qualification, without changing app defaults. No qualification results yet.
declared_model_provenance.publisher_role: third-party quantizer; not Qwen or ggml-org
declared_model_provenance.conversion_provenance_limit: Current upstream reference preserved for license/config; publisher does not supply exact conversion source revision, so conversion-source commit is not independently verified.
declared_model_provenance.runtime: Existing pinned llama.cpp b11963; architecture symbol found; artifact loading and actual planner quality remain unverified.
declared_model_provenance.selection_rationale: Qwen publishes agent and instruction-following evaluations for its 9B model; the dense hybrid architecture and 7.46 GB Q6 artifact fit the planned local comparison. These vendor results do not establish superiority in this application. No official Qwen/ggml-org Qwen3.5-9B GGUF was found; the third-party conversion is explicitly labelled.

hold_constant: Production source hash and bootstrap/action/node documentation
Media bytes, IDs and authority rules
llama.cpp b11963 binary, 8192 context and per-stage output budgets
Text-only structured action loop, no remote code or cloud inference
cases: Readable-label observation through actual OCR probe and preview to draft-ready
Unreadable-label counterfactual must alter the next action or stop inconclusive
Unavailable requested capability must not fabricate results or readiness
Mixed independent output branches require correct graph and actual preview
measures: Task outcome and actual probe/preview receipts
Repeated actions and meaningful observation-dependent changes
Cold/warm latency, prompt/decode rates, peak memory and swap
qualification_plan.acceptance_limit: Staging is not model qualification. Scripted protocol tests and vendor benchmarks are not live A0 acceptance.

declared_model_provenance.operational_changes: No server started/stopped; no app settings/source/model defaults changed; no existing models deleted.
